findings.title: Parser target is not three times all displayed baselines
findings.what: The document says every parser should remain under three times baseline and equates that with '< 4 ms'. For the two 1.4 ms baselines, three times baseline is 4.2 ms, so the displayed uniform threshold is arithmetically false and can reject a result that remains below 3×.
findings.fix: State per-parser thresholds (4.2 ms, 3.3 ms, 4.2 ms), or describe 4 ms as a deliberately stricter rounded common budget rather than as 3× baseline.
findings.acceptance: Recompute each displayed baseline multiplied by three and confirm every documented threshold matches it, or that any stricter common ceiling is explicitly labeled as such.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read of docs/perf-sprint/ingest-throughput.md:17-26 confirmed the displayed medians are 1.4, 1.1, and 1.4 ms; their exact 3× values are 4.2, 3.3, and 4.2 ms, not a uniform value below 4 ms.

findings.title: Tokens render verdict cites the wrong measured duration
findings.what: The verdict calls the Tokens initial-render figure 364 ms, but the three recorded runs are 367, 326, and 378 ms and their median is 367 ms, matching the measurement table and preceding finding text.
findings.acceptance: The Tokens verdict, measurement table, and median of the three recorded runs all report 367 ms.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the sorted runs are 326, 367, and 378 ms, so the median is reproducibly 367 ms; no 364 ms measurement appears in the file.

findings.title: Sessions resize layout exceeds its render budget by more than 10×
findings.what: The 18-session Sessions surface records a median 1,108 ms of resize-storm longtask time against a <=100 ms budget, plus 624 ms initial-load longtask time. The document attributes this to simultaneously laid-out grouped tables without virtualization and extrapolates roughly six seconds at the 100-session baseline scale.
findings.fix: Virtualize session rows and avoid independently laid-out nested tables per date group, then remeasure with the existing isolated-view harness.
findings.acceptance: At the documented 18-session corpus, the median Sessions resize-storm longtask total is <=100 ms across three isolated runs; also record a large-history run showing the cost does not grow roughly linearly with total rows.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read of the raw runs confirmed resize totals of 1108, 1254, and 212 ms, whose median is 1108 ms. The same file sets a <=100 ms budget and explicitly records absent virtualization; 1108/18×100 is about 6.16 seconds, consistent with the stated scale estimate.

findings.title: Tokens initial render remains above its declared budget
findings.what: The Tokens view records a 367 ms median initial-render longtask total against a <=200 ms target while mounting three chart instances simultaneously.
findings.fix: Defer offscreen chart mounting, for example with an intersection-triggered lazy mount, and remeasure using the documented isolated-view script.
findings.acceptance: At the documented 18-session corpus, the median Tokens initial-load longtask total is <=200 ms across three fresh-context runs without increasing resize-storm cost.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed initial-load runs of 367, 326, and 378 ms, a 367 ms median, and an explicit <=200 ms budget in the same file. The finding is based on the documented current measurement, not the erroneous 364 ms prose value.
